mechanism: Both drugs inhibit CYP3A4 and CYP2D6, potentially increasing oxybutynin plasma concentrations and anticholinergic effects; berberine may also enhance oxybutynin's pharmacodynamic anticholinergic activity.
action: Monitor for increased anticholinergic side effects (dry mouth, urinary retention, constipation, cognitive effects); consider dose reduction of oxybutynin if coadministered with berberine supplements.
